evidence.readmeExcerpt:
# Presence

让 coding agent 在多台服务器上「像在当地一样工作」。

不改远端、不装东西、不配环境：从你已有的 `~/.ssh/config` 里挑一台机器，连上之后，
读写、搜索、执行、开终端都走同一条常驻连接，操作感受和本地文件系统一致。

[![dsh-plugin](https://img.shields.io/badge/dsh--plugin-listing-2f6bff)](https://github.com/awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin)
[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-2f6bff)](LICENSE)
[![version](https://img.shields.io/badge/version-0.17.6-2f6bff)](docs/RELEASE.md)

> 也提供独立 **MCP server**（`mcp/`），让 Codex CLI / Claude Code / OpenCode 等不支持 DSH 插件的 agent
> 用上同一套远程能力：[`mcp/README.md`](mcp/README.md)。

![Presence 封面（浅色）](docs/social/cover-light.png)

---

## 为什么不是「agent 跑在远端」

| 方案 | 问题 |
| --- | --- |
| 每台服务器装 agent | 装 N 次、升级 N 次；要代理的机器还要逐台配代理 |
| agent 本机执行 `ssh host ...` | 每条命令一次握手；远端原生工具用不上；上下文不连续 |
| **Presence** | agent 留在本机（一套模型/代理/配置），能力通过一条常驻连接伸到远端 |

## 设计原则

1. **远端零安装**：只用 sshd 自带能力（SFTP 子系统、exec、shell/PTY），远端不落任何文件、不改任何配置。
2. **一次握手**：每台机器一条常驻 SSH 连接，之后所有操作都是这条连接上的请求，不再重连。
3. **用目标机的原生工具**：搜索交给目标机的 `rg`/`grep`，命令在目标机的 shell 里跑，路径语义、权限、编码都是本地的。
4. **像本地一样**：结构化返回（退出码、stdout/stderr 分开、超时、取消），文件写入是原子替换，编辑冲突会明确报错而不是猜。

## 架构

```
┌──────────────────────────────┐
│ DSH 插件（现在） / MCP（以后）│  同一内核，两种外壳
└──────────────┬───────────────┘
               │
        Presence 内核
        ├── ssh-config  从 ~/.ssh/config 读出主机、端口、用户、密钥、跳板
        ├── connection  一条常驻连接：SFTP / exec / PTY，通道池 + 取消 + 超时
        └── host pool   每台机器一条连接，按需建立、闲置回收
               │
        SSH（沿用你已有的密钥、known_hosts、跳板、代理）
               │
        目标机：Linux / macOS，sshd 自带能力即可
```

映射关系：

| Agent 的操作 | 走的通道 | 远端依赖 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 读 / 写 / 编辑 / 列目录 / stat | SFTP 子系统 | sshd 内置 `sftp-server` |
| 执行命令、搜索（rg/grep）、git | exec channel | 目标机已有的命令 |
| 交互式终端 | shell channel + PTY | 目标机的登录 shell |

## 实测（server，Ubuntu 20.04，IPv6）

| 操作 | 耗时 |
| --- | --- |
| 传统 `ssh host <cmd>`，每次新连接 | 520 – 540 ms |
| Presence 建连（一次握手，含密钥认证） | 145 ms |
| Presence `sftp stat` | p50 0.6 ms / p95 0.9 ms |
| Presence `exec true`（新通道 + 起 shell） | p50 7.6 ms |
| 8 个 exec 通道并发 | 合计 15 ms |
| 50 个 sftp 请求流水线并发 | 合计 3 – 13 ms |

即：把「每条命令一次握手」换成「一次握手 + 每次 0.6 ms」。

> 关键细节：必须开 TCP_NODELAY。不关 Nagle，请求/响应会撞上 delayed ACK，p95 从 0.9 ms 劣化到 48 ms。

## 在 DSH 里使用

仓库根目录本身就是一个 Bundle（`dsh.bundle.patch` 指向 `cordis.patch.yml`），安装：

```
plugin_manager { action: "install_bundle", target: "D:\\04_Dev\\Presence" }
```

装好后模型可见这些工具：

| 工具 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| `presence_hosts` | 列出 ssh config 里的机器与当前连接状态；默认主机（当前工作区所在机器）标 `*`；`format:"json"` => `[{alias,address,user,hostname,port,source,state,connected,default}]` |
| `presence_connect` | 建立常驻连接并报告远端身份；`format:"json"` => `{host,user,hostname,kernel,arch,platform,connectedAtMs}` |
| `presence_exec` | 在远端执行命令；默认 `pipefail`，支持 `background:true`、`waitForPort`、`timeoutMs`（超时会真杀进程树）；输出默认去 ANSI、首尾截断 16KiB（`maxOutput`/`raw` 可调），全量落盘并给路径；`format:"json"` 返回结构化 `{cwd, command, exitCode, signal, durationMs, timedOut, stdout, stderr, stdoutTruncated, stderrTruncated}`（stdout/stderr 各截 16KiB，仍是合法 JSON）；`saveStdout` 在 exit 0 后把 stdout 原子写到远端文件并报告字节数；**危险命令先 dry-run，需 `confirm:true`**；dry-run 在 `format:"json"` 下返回 `{dryRun,requiresConfirm,targets,command,report}` |
| `presence_trash` | **可恢复删除**：把路径移入远端 `~/.dsh/presence-trash/<时间戳>/`，返回恢复路径；`action:'trash'` 会回查源是否已消失（`sourceRemoved`）并给 `restoreHint`/`sizeBytes`，可用 `paths[]` 一次移 1–50 个（单项失败不拖累其余，单个 `path` 的返回形状不变）；`list` 时间正确格式化、最新在前、可用 `path` 过滤，JSON 每条只给一个 `movedAtISO`；`restore` 支持 `format:"json"` |
| `presence_jobs` | `list`（默认只看本会话）/ `status`（单任务：state/exit/pid/startedAt/logPath/logSize/command/cwd；运行中 `exitSummary` 为 `null`）/ `wait`（返回退出码 + 末尾日志，替代 sleep+tail；新增 `timedOut`）/ `stop`（按 jobId 或 pgid；停止后用远端 `ps -p` 验证 `alive`/`verified` 并给 exitCode/exitSignal，可再带 `port` 探测端口是否真的释放为 `portReleased`）；`list`/`status`/`wait`/`stop` 支持 `format:"json"` |
| `presence_read` | 读远端文件，带行号与 offset/limit；大文件走远端窗口读取（行数真实）；二进制明确拒绝；`raw:true` 返回逐字节原样内容（无路径头/行号/footer），`numbered:false` 去行号与 footer 但保留路径头；读完会给 harness 记账，内置 `edit` 可直接用 |
| `presence_read_many` | 一次读 1-50 个远端文件，按 `=== <path> ===` 分段；默认带行号、`raw:true` 原样，每文件最多 `limit` 行（默认 2000）；某个文件读不了只在该段报 `error: ...`，不会拖垮整次调用；总输出按 32KiB 截断 |
| `presence_write` | 原子整体写入，自动创建父目录；**保留原文件 mode**，可用 `mode:"755"` 显式指定；写后 `stat` 回读，报告真实字节数、八进制 mode（如 `0644`，未显式设置也绝不会显示 `0`）和**完整** sha256；`ifMatchSha256` 是乐观锁：文件当前哈希不匹配（或读不到）就报错并同时给出期望值/当前值，一个字节都不写；`format:"json"` => `{path, sizeBytes, mode, sha256}` |
| `presence_edit` | 精确文本替换（`old`/`new` 与 `replace_all` 别名都认），锚点不唯一就报错，保留 mode；返回上下文 ±2 行、最多 100 行/8KiB 的紧凑 diff；`dryRun:true` 只校验锚点并出 diff、不写文件，文本给出 `dry run: X B → Y B projected`；`format:"json"` => `{path, replaced, dryRun, bytesBefore, bytesAfter, sizeBytes, actualSizeBytes, projectedSizeBytes, diff}`（dryRun 时 `sizeBytes` 为磁盘现值，写入后为落盘大小） |
| `presence_search` | 远端 rg 搜索；`countOnly` 只返回数量，超限返回 `truncated`/总数，路径不存在或正则非法直接报错；`format:"json"` => `{pattern, root, countOnly, matchCount, matches:[{file, line, column?, text}]}` |
| `presence_glob` | 远端按 glob 找文件（支持绝对 pattern，返回 size/mtime，按新→旧排序）；`format:"json"` => `[{path, sizeBytes, mtimeISO, mtimeMs}]` |
| `presence_stat` | 一次远端 `stat -c` 批量报告 1–100 个路径：类型 / 大小 / 八进制 mode / mtime，`hash:true` 时对普通文件追加 sha256；**缺失路径返回 `exists:false`（`type:"missing"`）而不是整次失败**，所以它同时是存在性检查；符号链接默认只描述链接本身，`followSymlinks:true` 才穿透；`format:"json"` => `[{path, exists, type, sizeBytes, mode, mtimeISO, mtimeMs, sha256?}]` |
| `presence_port_probe` | 一次 exec 同时取回 `ss -ltnp` 的监听表（含 pid/process）和每个端口的 TCP 连接结果（`bash /dev/tcp`，无 bash 回退 python3 socket）：`ports` 1–20、`expect:"open"\|"closed"` 让 `ok` 直接表示「是否符合预期」、`waitMs` 每 250ms 轮询到满足或超时；用来证明服务真的起来了，或 stop/close 之后端口真的释放了；`format:"json"` => `[{port, listening, pid, process, probe, ok}]` |
| `presence_http_probe` | 一条调用完成「等远端端口 → 开转发 → 本地 fetch 多个 path → 断言状态码与响应体 → **finally 必关转发** → 验证本地端口已释放」：`paths` 默认 `["/"]`、`expectStatus` 默认 `[200]`、`expectBody` 为必须全部出现在（拼接后）响应体里的子串；`pass` = 状态码全中且子串全中；`format:"json"` => `{forwardId, localPort, remotePort, results, pass, portReleased}` |
| `presence_export` | 远端 → 本地真实文件（内容寻址去重、自动清理、返回 sha256），供 `present` / Explorer / Office 使用 |
| `presence_import` | **本地 → 远端**（截图、附件、构建产物等），二进制安全、可设 mode、返回 sha256；`format:"json"` => `{remotePath, localPath, sizeBytes, sha256, mode}`（完整哈希）；上限 64 MiB |
| `presence_forward` | 本地端口转发到远端端口（建立前预检端口）；`http://127.0.0.1:<port>` 访问远端服务；open/list/close 支持 `format:"json"` |
| `presence_terminal` | open / write / read / close 持久终端；open 可给 `cwd` 与 `command`（默认 bash）并返回 `{terminalId,host,cwd,shell}`；write 默认返回本次输出，`ackOnly:true` 只回 ack、输出留给 read；带 `session` 时用 tmux，断线可重连；`close {killSession}` 彻底结束；五个动作都支持 `format:"json"` |

> 远程会话里内置 `grep`/`glob` 由插件**接管并转发到远端**（路径、大小写、截断规则与 `presence_search` 一致），不再出现"扫本地盘、静默空"的情况。

**本地 ↔ 远程文件通道**：
- 本地 → 远程：`presence_import {source: "C:\\Users\\...\\attachments\\...\\a.png", to: "docs/a.png"}`
- 远程 → 本地：`presence_export {path: "docs/a.png"}` → 返回本机真实路径（再 `present` 才能被 GUI/预览看到）

### 危险命令护栏（防误删）

`presence_exec` 识别到 `rm -r/-f`、`git clean -fdx`、`find -delete`、`shred`、`truncate`、`dd of=/dev/...` 时**不会直接执行**：

1. 在"只报告不删除"的 shell 里重跑一遍（`rm` 被函数遮蔽、`find -delete` 换成 `-print`、`git clean` 加 `-n`），拿到**展开后的绝对目标**
2. 无变量未定义检查：命令里出现未设置的 `$VAR` 直接拒绝（这正是那次 `.tmesh` 被删的原因）
3. 无条件拒绝：工作区根目录、工作区根的任何祖先、家目录、`/`、`.git` 元数据
4. 其余情况返回报告（目标类型 / 文件数 / 体积），**要执行必须再调一次并带 `confirm:true`**

```
presence_exec {command: "rm -rf .tmesh/$J"}
→ destructive command needs confirmation (rm): nothing was executed yet
  resolved targets:
    dir  /srv/app/TensorMesh/.tmesh  128 files  42.1 MB
  Pass confirm:true to execute it. Prefer presence_trash ...
```

工作区里要删东西，优先 `presence_trash {action:'trash', path:'build'}`：它是"移动到回收站 + 返回恢复路径"，零安装（就是远端 `mv`），后悔了 `action:'restore'` 放回去。

**长任务推荐姿势**：`presence_exec {command, background:true}` → 拿到 jobId → `presence_jobs {action:'wait', jobId}` 等它结束（返回退出码和末尾日志）→ 需要时 `presence_jobs {action:'stop'}`。

**「它真的起来了吗」一条调用验完**：`presence_port_probe {ports:[8010], expect:'open', waitMs:8000}` 同时给出监听表（pid/process）和 TCP 探测结果；`presence_http_probe {remotePort:8010, paths:['/','/src/main.js'], expectBody:['id="game"']}` 自己完成「等端口 → 开转发 → 本地 fetch → 断言 → 关转发 → 验证本地端口已释放」，不会留下悬挂隧道。`presence_stat` 则把 `stat`/`sha256sum`/`test -e` 这类兜底查询合并成一次远端调用（缺失路径返回 `exists:false`）。

配置项（写在 `cordis.patch.yml` 的 `config` 里，会被你的补丁层覆盖）：

| 字段 | 默认 | 含义 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `maxChannels` | 8 | 每连接并发通道数（sshd `MaxSessions` 默认 10，留一个给 SFTP） |
| `connectTimeoutMs` | 25000 | 单次连接尝试上限 |
| `idleTimeoutMs` | 900000 | 空闲多久断开；仍持有终端的连接不会被回收 |
| `readOnly` | false | 拒绝写入与编辑，读取/搜索/执行不受影响 |

### 工作区（这是使用入口）

面板：**设置 → Presence**

1. 「新建」→ 选一台机器（要密码的当场输入，可勾「记住这台」）；列表里的绿点 = 这台机器当前**已连接**，面板每 5 秒窗口获得焦点时都会刷新，不用重开
2. 连接后进入**远程目录浏览器**：机器徽标 + 路径面包屑 + 条目计数；文件夹/文件分开排序，文件显示大小，条目多的目录自动出现筛选框
3. 「用这个文件夹」→ 生成一个远程工作区
4. 工作区按**机器分组**：每台机器一行（绿点 = 这台机器当前已连接），下面挂它的文件夹；可「浏览文件」（进入子目录、点文件在下方预览）「移除」

**手动主机（不在 `~/.ssh/config` 里也可以）**：在选机器界面点「手动添加主机」，粘贴一条 ssh 命令即可，例如

```text
ssh -CAXY user@server
```

或者更简单的 `user@host[:2222]` / `ssh://user@host:2202` / `[IPv6]:port`。Presence 会解析 `-p`、`-l`、`-i`、`-A`、`-C`、`-o`（含 `ProxyJump` 警告）等参数，把主机保存在 `~/.dsh/presence/hosts.json`（**不会改 `~/.ssh/config`**），并在主机列表里标「手动」、可随时删除。手动主机和 config 主机在 `/state`、工作区、文件浏览器、终端里完全等价。

> 不再有「设为当前」：每个会话以自己的 cwd 决定用哪台机器/哪个根，左侧每个远程工作区打开就能用。

**改远端文件请用 `edit` / `write` / `presence_edit` / `presence_write`**，不要用 `sed -i`、`perl -pi` 或 shell 重定向——前者是原子写、有歧义拒绝和版本守卫，后者会绕过这些保护。

会话在某个远程工作区里时，**agent 的工具不再需要 host**：

| 调用 | 行为 |
| --- | --- |
| `presence_exec(command)` | 在那台机器的那个工作区根目录下执行 |
| `presence_read('src/app.ts')` | 解析成 `<工作区根>/src/app.ts` |
| `presence_read_many(['src/a.ts', 'src/b.ts'])` | 一次读多个文件，各自解析到 `<工作区根>/...` |
| `presence_write` / `presence_edit` / `presence_search` / `presence_glob` | 同上，相对路径都相对工作区根 |
| 绝对路径 / `~/路径` / `presence://host/path` / 本地挂载路径 | 全部等价可用；跨主机路径会明确报错 |

每个模型步骤都会注入一行运行时上下文，说明当前会话是不是远程工作区、能用哪些工具。

### 路径与权限矩阵（容易踩坑的地方）

| 操作 | 相对路径 | 远端绝对 `/srv/...` | `presence://host/path` | 本地挂载 `C:\...\mounts\...` |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 内置 `read`/`write`/`edit` | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ |
| 内置 `grep`/`glob` | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅（插件转发到远端） |
| 内置 `read_image` | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅（走 ctx.fs.readBytes，不需要先导出） |
| `presence_*` 工具 | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ |
| `present` | 卡片预览 ✅ | — | — | 卡片预览 ✅ / **原生打开 ❌** |
| Office / Python 等宿主程序 | 仅本地文件 | — | — | **❌ 需先 `presence_export`** |

**工具远程能力一览**（哪些不用换写法）：
- **自动远程**：`read`/`write`/`edit`（走挂载路径）、`grep`/`glob`（插件拦截转发）、`read_image`（走 ctx.fs 读字节，需 image-capable 模型）、`presence_*` 全套
- **需要显式转换**：`present` 的原生打开、Office/Python 等宿主程序 → 先 `presence_export`，需要反向则 `presence_import`
- **只看本地**：宿主 `glob`/`grep` 之外的本地命令、`pwsh`

权限：
- **ctx.fs 的写入范围 = 会话自己的工作区**（DSH `workspace-write` 策略）。工作区外（例如工作区是 `/srv/app`、你要写 `/srv/workspace`）会被 DSH 沙箱拒绝 —— 这是**策略限制，不是远端权限**；用 `presence_write` / `presence_exec` 就能写。
- 远端 `/tmp` 同理：`ctx.fs` 不写远端 `/tmp`，用 `presence_write` / `presence_exec`。
- 写入路径会做**远端 realpath 校验**：工作区里的符号链接指向工作区外时，写入会被拒绝（防沙箱逃逸）。
- 覆盖写会**保留原文件 mode**（可执行文件不会因为 `edit` 变成 644）；新文件默认 644，可用 `presence_write {mode}` / `presence_import {mode}` 指定。
- `present` 只记录路径：远程文件在应用内**预览可用**，但「原生打开」按钮不行；要在外部程序打开，先 `presence_export` 成真实本地文件再 `present`。

工作区记录在 `~/.dsh/presence/workspaces.json`；同一 (机器, 目录) 只会有一条。

### 真正的 DSH 工作区（本地挂载点）

远程文件夹会以**本地挂载点**的形式注册成真正的 DSH 工作区：

```
C:\Users\<你>\.dsh\presence\mounts\<主机>\<远端绝对路径>
```

这个本地目录是**空的占位**，只为通过工作区注册表用 `node:fs/realpath` 做的「必须是真实目录」校验。Presence 的文件系统提供方把该目录下**所有路径**映射回远端，所以：

| 行为 | 状态 |
| --- | --- |
| 左侧「工作区」列表出现该远程工作区 | ✅ |
| 在它里面新建会话，cwd 是远程路径 | ✅ |
| 文件树展开远程目录 | ✅ |
| 内置 `read` / `write` / `edit` | ✅ 直接读写远端 |
| 内置 `grep` / `glob` | ✅ 插件拦截并转发到远端（不是扫本地盘） |
| `presence_exec` / `presence_terminal` | ✅ 在远端执行 |

### 认证

- **密钥**：ssh-agent → `IdentityFile` → 默认密钥（`id_ed25519`、`id_rsa`），按顺序尝试，失败原因归一化成人话。
- **密码**：默认**只存在进程内存**，不落盘、不进会话日志。面板就绪前，可以用环境变量
  `PRESENCE_PASSWORD_<ALIAS>`（别名大写、非字母数字换成下划线）提供，例如 `PRESENCE_PASSWORD_MY_SERVER`。
- **「记住这台」**：面板里的开关，默认关闭；打开后密码交给 DSH 的凭据服务保管（落盘方式由该服务决定），重启免输。

### 面板终端 = 远程 shell

DSH 右侧的终端面板原本只会起**本机** shell，cwd 被设成挂载路径（空壳目录）。Presence 把 `terminal-controller` 的默认 shell 换成了一个 launcher（`scripts/presence-shell.ps1`，以 `-EncodedCommand` 内嵌在 `cordis.patch.yml` 里）：

| 打开终端的会话 | 实际启动 |
| --- | --- |
| 远程工作区（cwd 在 `~/.dsh/presence/mounts/<host>/...` 下） | `ssh -t <host> "cd '<远端目录>' && exec $SHELL -l"` —— 就是那台机器、那个目录 |
| 本地工作区 / 其它 cwd | 本机 `cmd.exe`，与原生行为一致 |

所以：**在远程工作区点「新终端」，直接看到远端目录的提示符**；`git`、`tmux`、补全、颜色都走远端环境，远端仍然零安装（只用 ssh 客户端）。

- launcher 源码在 `scripts/presence-shell.ps1`；改完运行 `node scripts/embed-shell.mjs` 重新内嵌（打包脚本会做 `--check`，stale 直接失败）
- 想恢复原生行为：删掉 `cordis.patch.yml` 里 `# >>> presence-shell ... <<<` 那一段，重启
- 需要密码的机器：ssh 会在终端里提示输入；密钥/ssh-agent 的机器无感
- 终端窗口关掉 = ssh 断开；需要跨断线的持久 shell 用 agent 的 `presence_terminal {session}`（远端 tmux）

### 侧边栏文件浏览器（XFTP 风格）

右侧栏「开始」页多了一项 **远程文件**：一个远程目录面板，可以像 Xftp 一样传文件。

| 操作 | 行为 |
| --- | --- |
| 拖本地**文件**到列表 / `＋ 文件` | 上传到当前远端目录，底部显示百分比进度 |
| 拖本地**文件夹**到列表 / `＋ 文件夹` | 按原目录结构递归 `mkdir` + 逐文件上传（有进度） |
| 双击图片 | 弹窗预览（走 `/raw` 直出字节） |
| 双击视频 / 音频 / PDF | 弹窗内原生播放器（`<video controls>` / `<audio controls>`）或 PDF 阅读器（`<iframe>`，`/raw` 支持 Range，可拖动进度） |
| 双击文本 / 代码 | 弹窗内 **CodeMirror 6** 只读预览：行号、代码折叠、语法高亮（按扩展名识别语言，JSON/YAML/TOML/XML/Markdown 也走同一视图）、等宽字体（Cascadia Code / Consolas 兜底）、跟随主题明暗配色、一键复制；文本上限 1 MiB，超出时顶部提示「已截断」 |
| 双击其它类型（或预览失败） | 调起系统「另存为」对话框（File System Access API；不可用时回退浏览器下载） |
| 行尾 `↓` 文件 | 保存单个文件到本地 |
| 行尾 `↓` 文件夹 | 选一个本地目标文件夹 → **递归下载成真实目录树**（Xftp 的"下载文件夹"），底部有进度 |
| 行尾 `🗑` | 移到**远端回收站**（可恢复，见 `presence_trash`） |
| `新建` / `⟳` / 筛选框 | 新建文件夹 / 刷新 / 过滤当前目录 |
| 顶栏下拉 | 切换机器（默认跟随当前会话的工作区，没有则用第一个工作区） |
| 需要密码的机器 | 自动弹**密码对话框**（密码 / 「记住这台」/ 取消），连上后继续浏览当前目录 |
| 取消「选择目标文件夹」 | 视为取消，不报错 |

界面按 [OpenDesign](https://open-design.ai/zh/plugins/design-system-agentic/) 的规范实现，并**全部落在 harness 主题自己的 token 上**：4px 间距网格、圆角 4/8/12/pill（`--dsw-radius-*`）、`1px ring + 柔阴影`、动效 `100ms/300ms` + `cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1)`（`--ds-transition-duration-*` + `--ds-ease-in-out`）、交互底色 `--dsw-alias-interactive-bg-hover`、选中 `--dsw-alias-bg-multi-select`、强调 `--dsw-alias-state-business-primary`；图标为内置描边 SVG（不再用 emoji），行内文本禁止选中，工具栏/面包屑/操作按钮均为图标按钮。

**关于"拖出"的准确说法**：
- **文件可以拖出**到资源管理器：Chromium 的 `DownloadURL` 机制会把 URL 下载成临时文件再交给系统。
- **文件夹不能拖出**，这是 web 平台限制而不是没实现：`DownloadURL` 只能表达"一个文件"；拖出目录必须由 Electron 主进程调 `webContents.startDrag({ files: [目录] })`，而 DSH 的 host 是独立 Node 子进程（`app.asar/lib/main.js:3794` `spawn(node)`），主进程与 host 之间只有 `/api/*` 转发，没有拖拽通道。要真正支持需要 DSH 上游加一条 IPC。
- 等价的文件夹下载已实现（`↓` → 选目标目录 → 递归落地）。
- 从资源管理器往页面拖**文件和文件夹**都稳定可用，且面板会拦截这次拖放（`stopPropagation`），不会再把文件同时塞进右侧聊天框。

### 右侧栏「端口转发」

远程机器上跑的网页服务（`npm run dev`、Jupyter、Gradio……）不用记 ssh 命令，右侧栏第二个标签 **端口转发** 就是它的列表：

| 操作 | 行为 |
| --- | --- |
| 顶部表单（机器 / 远程主机 / 远程端口 / 本地端口） | 每个字段有可见标签；两行自适应布局，窄侧边栏也不会挤成一团。**本地端口留空时默认与远程端口相同**（8000 → 8000），被占用自动换一个随机端口并提示，也可以手动指定 |
| 列表 | 按机器分组显示**当前所有转发**：`远程:端口 → 127.0.0.1:本地端口`；每行是图标按钮：↗ 打开（新标签直连）/ 复制 URL（点后变 ✓）/ 电源图标停止（hover 变红） |
| 自动刷新 | 每 4 秒刷新一次：agent 用 `presence_forward` 开的隧道、或从别处关掉的隧道都会同步过来 |
| 状态提示 | 首次进入显示加载动画；机器未连接时分组头标「未连接」；需要密码的机器会提示先去「远程文件」面板连接一次 |
| 设置 → Presence | 工作区列表下方有一张卡片式只读列表（数量 chip + 地址 + 停止），不看右侧栏也能知道在转发什么 |
| 底层 | 与 `presence_forward` 工具共用同一个注册表（`pool.openForward/listTunnels/closeTunnel`），HTTP API：`GET/POST/DELETE /api/presence/tunnels` |

> 端口转发只在本地 `127.0.0.1` 上监听；隧道随连接断开或插件卸载自动关闭。

**agent 也能开转发**：对 agent 说「把远程 8000 转发到本地」即可，它调用 `presence_forward`：

```text
presence_forward { "action": "open", "remotePort": 8000 }
→ opened forward f3
  local:  http://127.0.0.1:8000        ← 默认与远程同号；被占用会自动换并注明
  remote: server:127.0.0.1:8000
  The right-sidebar 端口转发 panel lists it automatically ...
```

面板每 4 秒轮询同一个注册表，所以 agent 开的隧道会**自动出现**在右侧栏（设置页那张卡片也会同步）。

### 通知与错误

所有错误和信息提示走**同一套通知**，不再各自糊一个红色内联块：

| 特性 | 说明 |
| --- | --- |
| 位置 / 形态 | 窗口右下角栈式卡片（最多 5 条），**z-index 高于设置弹窗遮罩**，不会被压暗；左侧 severity 色条 + 图标 + 标题 + 建议 + 原始报错（等宽小字） |
| 语言 | 跟随页面语言（**运行时读取 `<html lang>`**，不依赖模块加载时的快照）：中文环境全部中文；后端 ssh 的英文报错（认证失败、端口无监听、连接拒绝、DNS、超时、权限、无文件…）自动映射成中文标题 + 建议，原文保留为细节；英文环境走英文目录 |
| 动画 | 进场 220ms 上浮淡入、退场 170ms 下沉淡出，底部还有一条随剩余时间收缩的进度条；`prefers-reduced-motion` 下自动关闭动画 |
| 停留时间 | 成功 2.6s / 信息 3.6s / 警告 5.2s / 错误 **7s**，可手动点 × 关闭；错误不会再被后台轮询"瞬间清掉" |
| 去重 | 同一条错误 8 秒内只弹一次，轮询失败不会刷屏 |
| 覆盖范围 | 设置面板、远程文件面板、端口转发面板共用一个通知栈（`react-dom` 挂 `document.body`，单例） |

## 当前状态

- [x] 解析 `~/.ssh/config`（Host / HostName / Port / User / IdentityFile / Include / 全局默认 / 引号）
- [x] 密钥认证：ssh-agent、多密钥顺序尝试、失败原因归一化
- [x] SFTP 读 / 原子写 / 精确替换编辑 / 列目录 / stat / 二进制读取
- [x] exec：独立通道、超时、取消、退出码、stdout/stderr 分离
- [x] 通道池（受 sshd `MaxSessions` 约束）
- [x] PTY 终端，随连接存活
- [x] DSH Bundle：18 个工具，已装进 profile 并实测
- [x] 密码认证（进程内存 / 环境变量），已接入连接层
- [x] 设置页面板：服务器选择 → 远程目录浏览 → 创建远程工作区
- [x] 工作区作用域：设为当前后，工具不需要 host，相对路径相对工作区根，上下文自动切换
- [x] 面板内浏览工作区文件、预览内容
- [x] 面板 API：仅本机 + 同源防护，跨站请求返回 403
- [x] 每个模型步骤注入一行运行时上下文：工作区绑定（或机器总数 + 已连接清单）
- [x] 断线自愈：连接掉线后被标记失效，下一次调用自动重建，无需手动重连
- [ ] 密码登录的端到端实测（代码已就绪，暂无支持密码的目标机可测）
- [ ] ProxyJump / ProxyCommand
- [ ] 终端跨连接恢复（需要目标机已有 tmux 时复用）
- [ ] MCP server（内核无 DSH 依赖，抽出即可复用）

## 已知边界

- **挂载路径是虚拟的**：`~/.dsh/presence/mounts/...` 只对 `ctx.fs` 生效，Explorer / Office / 宿主 Python 看不到远程文件（见上面的能力矩阵）。
- **并发上限**：sshd 默认 `MaxSessions 10`，一条连接最多 10 个通道（已留一个给 SFTP，池子上限 8）。这是服务器策略，不是插件限制。
- **终端生命周期**：PTY 跟随连接存活；需要跨断线/重启时用 `presence_terminal {session}`，它在目标机复用 `tmux`（仍然零安装）。
- **SFTP 语义**：写文件用 `writeFile` + OpenSSH `posix-rename` 扩展做原子替换；没有该扩展的服务器退化为「删除后重命名」。覆盖写保留原文件 mode；新文件 644（受远端 umask 影响，可用 `mode` 指定）。
- **`present` 的原生打开**：卡片预览可用，但"原生打开"按钮要求宿主进程能映射该路径；虚拟挂载路径映射不了，需先 `presence_export`。
- **`read-before-write` 守卫**：只对内置 fs 工具生效；`presence_write` 绕开它，但会通过 `fs/observed` 事件给内置 `write`/`edit` 记账，所以两边可以混用。

## 开发与版本管理

源码在 git 里（`main` 分支，版本用 tag 标记，例如 `v0.14.0`）。仓库只跟踪源码；**`client.js` 是构建产物**，源码在 `client-src/`：

```bash
npm install                       # 运行时依赖只有 ssh2；node_modules 不进 git
npm install --prefix .dev --ignore-scripts rollup @rollup/plugin-node-resolve \
  @rollup/plugin-commonjs @rollup/plugin-terser codemirror @codemirror/language-data @codemirror/theme-one-dark
node scripts/build-client.mjs     # client-src/{entry,app,editor}.js → client.js（IIFE，含 CodeMirror）
powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/package.ps1 -Version 0.14.0
# → dist/presence-plugin-0.14.0.zip（内含 node_modules 与已构建的 client.js，可直接被 DSH 安装）
```

`package.ps1` 会先跑 `build-client.mjs`，保证 zip 里的 `client.js` 与源码一致；`client-src/node_modules`、`.dev/`、`.npm-cache/` 都在 gitignore 里。

改动后至少跑这些验证（都需要一台可 ssh 的主机）：

```bash
node scripts/regression.mjs server   # 传输层：符号链接写、行数、超时、落盘、二进制
node scripts/job-probe.mjs server    # 后台任务 + 端口转发
node scripts/feature-probe.mjs server # wait/会话过滤/pgid/就绪/搜索语义
node scripts/import-probe.mjs server # 本地→远程二进制、mode、sha256
node scripts/safety-probe.mjs server # 危险命令护栏 + 观测状态存储
```

`scripts/isolated-check.mjs` 需要在 Electron-as-Node 下跑（路径矩阵 + 沙箱围栏），打包时不会带进 zip。

## 运行

```bash
node scripts/probe.mjs server
```

需要本机有 Node ≥ 22.19。`ssh2` 是唯一的运行时依赖。

## Star History

[![Star History Chart](assets/star-history.png)](https://star-history.com/#fanrj3/dsh-presence&Date)

# DeepSeek Meme [English](README.en.md) · 简体中文 A sticker library for **DeepSeek Harness (DSH)** — a composer button and panel, two bundled sticker packs, and a `send_sticker` tool that lets the model understand and reply with stickers.

> Listed in the [awesome-dsh-plugin](https://awesome-dsh-plugin.com/p/FeWOO/DeepSeek-meme/) community catalog. ## 为什么做这个 DSH 的对话里一直没有“表情包”这个位置：用户只能打字，模型看不懂别人贴的图，也谈不上用表情回话。DeepSeek Meme 把这件事做成聊天的一部分： - **点一下就能发**：模型选择栏旁的表情按钮，打开面板，点贴纸立即发送。 - **只发图片**：贴纸以纯图片消息进入会话，不带含义文字；发送时缩到 180px，明显小于普通图片。 - **模型看得懂**：每个贴纸都有 `name / meaning / tags`，模型可以看图理解，也可以查目录精确确认。 - **模型也能发**：`send_sticker` 工具让模型主动挑一张贴纸回你，并以 150px 内联小图出现在回复里。 - **表情包是自己的**：面板里可以新建包、添加图片、改名称/含义/标签、移动和删除；数据只在本机。 ## 功能 | 能力 | 说明 | | --- | --- | | 输入区表情按钮 | 挂在 `conversation.input.right`，位于模型选择器与发送键之间 | | 表情面板 | 挂在 `conversation.input.dock`，支持包切换、网格浏览、添加、编辑、删除 | | 点击发送 | 180px 纯图片用户消息（`messageStickerSize` 可调 96–240） | | 添加贴纸 | PNG / JPEG / WebP / GIF；上传时自动校验格式与大小 | | 表情编辑 | 名称、含义、标签、所属包；含义会进入模型可查的目录 | | 模型发表情 | `send_sticker`（list / send），工具卡默认展开 + 150px 内联小图 | | 随包表情 | 「默认表情」10 张 + 「鲸鱼娘二创梗图」8 张，首次运行自动播种 | | 本地存储 | 素材与目录保存在 `DSH_HOME/memes`，不上传、不联网 | ## 截图 | 默认表情（10 张） | 社区二创梗图（8 张） | | --- | --- | | | | ## 安装 要求：**DeepSeek Harness 0.2.1-rc.2**（Desktop / Web profile 均可）。 ```powershell dsh plugin add github:FeWOO/DeepSeek-meme ``` 也可以在 DSH 的 **Plugins → Discover / Plugin Market** 里搜索 `DeepSeek-meme`，或通过社区目录页面安装： - 社区目录： - Release： > 当前这台机器通过 `desktop` profile 的本地链接安装；更新 Host 代码后需要重启 DSH，或对插件行 disable → enable。Client 改动通常随 HMR 生效。 ## 使用 1. 在对话输入区点击 🐋 表情按钮。 2. 选择一个表情包标签页，点击贴纸即可发送。 3. 悬停贴纸右上角的 ✎ 可以编辑名称、含义、标签、所属包，或删除。 4. 点击「＋ 添加表情」选择本地图片；点击「＋」新建表情包。 5. 和模型聊天时，模型也可以通过 `send_sticker` 主动回发表情。 **用户发送**：只发图片，不带说明文字；图片会缩到 180px 再进入会话。 **模型发送**：工具结果带一张 150px 内联 Markdown 小图，直接出现在回复里；同时保留可点击放大的 durable attachment。 ## 随包表情 ### 默认表情 `whale-gpt`（10 张） 收到！、谢谢你~、我来啦！、辛苦啦、晚安安、早安~、喝奶茶中...、嗯…?、哼！、好困… - 640px 长边 WebP，透明背景，白边贴纸样式。 - 含义与标签见 [docs/ASSETS.md](docs/ASSETS.md)。 ### 鲸鱼娘二创梗图 `whale-community`（8 张） 举手开心、DeepSeek完蛋了、她不是生来就只有战火、用户造反、瞪你、给我跪下、吃饱饱、大胆的想法。 > 该包为用户提供的社区二创同人图，版权归原作者；公开分发或商用前请确认授权。 两个包独立保留。新增/删除 `assets/*/manifest.json` 目录即可增删随包表情包；同一 `pack.id` 会保留用户编辑。 ## 配置 在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 中调整： ```yaml - id: deepseek-meme name: dsh-deepseek-meme config: dataDir: '' # 默认 /memes maxStickerBytes: 1048576 # 单张上传上限 maxStickersPerPack: 500 # 每个包上限 messageStickerSize: 180 # 用户贴纸消息长边（96–240） ``` ## 架构 - **Host**：本地贴纸库、`/api/memes/*` 路由、`send_sticker` 工具、系统提示段。 - **Client**：`conversation.input.right` 按钮、`conversation.input.dock` 面板、`tool.call.toolview` 工具卡。 - **数据**：`DSH_HOME/memes/catalog.json` + `assets/`，原子写入、串行化、多随包目录同步。 - **会话**：用户贴纸走正常 `user/message` 图片块；模型贴纸走工具结果 + 内联小图；不伪造 Session 事件。 详细设计见 [docs/ARCHITECTURE.md](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md)，HTTP 契约见 [docs/API.md](docs/API.md)。 ## 隐私与权限 - 只读写 `DSH_HOME/memes`；不访问其他目录。 - 不联网抓取素材，不上传图片，不发送遥测。 - 图片读取通过 DSH 附件服务完成；上传内容会做媒体类型与大小校验，拒绝 SVG。 - 路由只在 DSH Web 同源下提供，目录接口带 `no-store`，素材接口带长缓存。 ## 兼容性与验证 - 目标版本：DSH Desktop / Web **0.2.1-rc.2**。 - 已实测：双包播种、目录/素材路由、贴纸 CRUD、用户 180px 发送、模型 150px 内联发表情、社区目录收录。 - 验证记录与已知限制：[docs/VERIFICATION.md](docs/VERIFICATION.md)。 ## 项目结构 ```text DeepSeek-meme/ ├─ index.js Host 半：存储、路由、send_sticker、提示词 ├─ client.js Web Client 半：按钮、面板、工具卡 ├─ cordis.patch.yml bundle patch ├─ package.json DSH bundle / client 清单 ├─ assets/ │ ├─ default/ 默认表情（10 张） │ ├─ community/ 社区二创梗图（8 张） │ └─ gpt/ 拆分源 PNG（不随 npm 包分发） └─ docs/ ├─ ARCHITECTURE.md 架构与设计 ├─ API.md HTTP API ├─ ASSETS.md 表情含义与素材说明 ├─ DEVELOPMENT.md 开发、安装、验证 ├─ PUBLISHING.md 发布与社区目录记录 ├─ VERIFICATION.md 实测证据 └─ ROADMAP.md 路线图 ``` ## 开发 ```powershell node --check index.js node --check client.js ``` 安装、宿主重载、冒烟验证和 Git 工作流见 [docs/DEVELOPMENT.md](docs/DEVELOPMENT.md)。 ## 贡献 欢迎提交 Issue / PR：新表情包、含义校对、UI 细节、兼容性修复都可以。提交 PR 前请先看 [docs/DEVELOPMENT.md](docs/DEVELOPMENT.md)，并保持 `dsh.bundle` / `cordis.patch.yml` 可用。 ## License [MIT](LICENSE) © 2026 FeWOO [![](https://img.shields.io/badge/powered_by-dsh-4D6BFE?style=flat-square&logo=deepseek&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)

# Touchstone **An AI-agent-driven automated testing platform.** Point it at a repository; it explores the code, writes and runs test cases, files what breaks, fixes it, and re-verifies the fix. [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE) [![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/@gavinc-cn/touchstone-dsh?logo=npm&color=cb3837)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@gavinc-cn/touchstone-dsh) [![Python 3.12+](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-3.12%2B-3776AB.svg)](https://www.python.org/) [![Node 22.19+ | 24+](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node-22.19%2B%20%7C%2024%2B-339933.svg)](https://nodejs.org/) [![DeepSeek Harness plugin](https://img.shields.io/badge/DeepSeek%20Harness-plugin-4D6BFE.svg)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) English | [中文](README.zh.md)
## What is Touchstone? Touchstone turns "we really should test more" into a running loop. You register a project — its source directory, a working directory, and the house rules the agent must follow — and Touchstone drives an AI agent through [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (`dsh`) to **generate test cases, execute them, report failures as bug reports, fix the code, and re-verify the fix**. Every artifact lands on disk in a reviewable form: a case library of Markdown case files, a `bug_report/` directory, and per-round logs. It is not a one-shot "run my test suite" CLI. Touchstone is built around **long-lived, multi-round agent sessions**: a task runs round after round in the same session with its context intact, so the agent remembers what it already tried. A unified queue keeps exactly one writer per project (no two agents editing the same checkout at once), and the whole thing is observable — live round logs, a rendered session window, and an SSE-backed board. Touchstone runs **locally**. Standalone mode is a Python web site; plugin mode defaults to the bundled Node backend (since 2026-10-15, with `backend: python` as the one-line fallback). Either way it is a SQLite database plus a file-system workspace, and no data leaves your machine except for the model calls your `dsh` host makes. ## Highlights - **Six task types** covering the whole QA loop — exploration, regression, stress, fix, retest, and case revision — each following a seven-stage lifecycle (generate cases → execute → report → analyze → fix → deploy → retest). - **A case library, not a test log.** Cases are human-readable Markdown (`case.md` + `status.md` per case, plus an `INDEX.md` per directory). Agents read and extend them across tasks; you can fix a bad case by editing a file. - **Bug reports as first-class artifacts.** Failures are written up as structured reports (severity, reproduction steps, log evidence, related cases) and can be routed back into fix / retest / case-revision tasks from the UI. - **Unified per-project queue.** Tasks, board cards, and chat messages all take the same serial slot per project; queue position, the current holder, and evidence are queryable rather than guessed. - **A board for agent-driven development.** Kanban cards start, queue, block, and complete agent sessions; cards can run in an isolated `git worktree` so exploratory work never touches your main checkout. - **Observable sessions.** Render the full transcript of any agent session (messages, reasoning, tool calls, results), reply to it, inject into the running turn, compact it, fork it, or rewind to an earlier point through a fork. - **Stress testing built in.** A stress task asks the agent for a scenario + script; the platform then drives the load itself, N runs per task, with per-run metrics, charts, and Markdown/JSON reports. - **Optional integrations.** Feishu (Lark) push notifications with two-way answering from chat cards, and RAG-based semantic search over the case library. - **Self-contained stack.** Backend: the bundled Node backend (plugin-mode default, needs Node 22.19+) or the Python standard library plus four small dependencies (standalone mode / `backend: python`). Frontend: React + Vite. Storage: SQLite + plain files. Runs on Linux and Windows. ## Screenshots The development board — cards per column, task entries inline, per-project queue badges: ![Development board](docs/images/board.png) Test tasks — six task types, round counts, statuses, and per-task actions: ![Test tasks](docs/images/tasks.png) The session window — the full agent transcript rendered from the `dsh` session store, with reply, approval, and model controls: ![Session window](docs/images/session.png) Card detail — description, scheduling, dependent cards, bound sessions, and comments: ![Card detail](docs/images/card-detail.png) ## How it works ```mermaid flowchart LR U[Browser] -->|REST + SSE| S["Touchstone server
Python stdlib · SQLite · files"] S -->|"/touchstone-agent
resident sessions"| D["dsh host
DeepSeek Harness"] D -->|"read / edit / bash"| R["Your repository"] D --> C[("Case library
free_style/")] D --> B[("Bug reports
bug_report/")] S --- C S --- B ``` 1. **You create a project.** Touchstone stores the repository path, a work directory, optional project skills, and free-form guidance that is injected into every first-round prompt. 2. **You create a task.** Pick a type (say, *Exploration*) and an end stage (say, *report*), and Touchstone queues it for that project. 3. **Rounds run in a resident agent session.** Touchstone asks the `dsh` plugin to create or resume a session and sends the round prompt. Rounds stream back to the UI and to `/.web/task__round_.log` as they happen. 4. **Artifacts land in your work directory.** New cases under `free_style/`, bug reports under `bug_report/`, monitoring state under `.live/`. You review them like code. 5. **Follow-up tasks close the loop.** A report can spawn a fix task, a fix can spawn a retest, and a rejected report can spawn a case-revision task. When a task's end stage goes past "report", the platform appends the downstream stages as a follow-up task automatically. ### Task types | Type | What the agent does | Typical end stage | |------|---------------------|-------------------| | Exploration | Reads the code and writes new test cases into the case library | Report | | Regression | Re-runs existing cases (optionally limited to a commit date range) | Report | | Stress | Produces a load scenario + driver script, then the platform runs the load | Report | | Fix | Analyzes a bug report, patches the code, deploys, and re-tests | Fix / Deploy / Retest | | Retest | Re-verifies one bug report (retest only, deploy + retest, or deploy only) | Retest | | Case revision | Rejects a bug report as a bad case and rewrites the case instead | Revision | ### Core concepts | Concept | Meaning | |---------|---------| | Project | A repository plus its work directory, agent binding, and guidance | | Task | One queued unit of work: a task type, a stage range, a stop condition, and a round history | | Round | One prompt/response cycle in the task's agent session | | Case library | `/free_style/` — Markdown cases, status files, and per-directory indexes | | Bug report | `/bug_report/_FS_/` — the failure dossier for a case | | Card | A board item that can start, queue, and drive its own agent session | | Queue | The per-project serial slot shared by tasks, cards, and chat messages | ## Quick start ### Prerequisites | Requirement | Version | Needed for | |-------------|---------|------------| | Node.js | 22.19+ or 24+ | The `dsh` host **and the plugin-mode backend** (default; the front-end build alone needs Node 18+) | | Python | 3.12+ | Standalone mode (`./touchstone.sh start`) and plugin mode with `backend: python` (verified on 3.12) | | DeepSeek Harness (`dsh`) | current release | Agent execution — required for plugin mode | ### 1. Clone and install ```bash git clone https://github.com/gavinc-cn/touchstone-dsh.git cd touchstone-dsh python3 -m pip install -r backend_py/requirements.txt # needed for standalone mode / plugin mode with backend: python ``` ### 2. Start the site (standalone mode) ```bash ./touchstone.sh start # builds the front end on first run, then serves 127.0.0.1:4601 ./touchstone.sh status # PID and the actual port ./touchstone.sh stop ``` Then open <http://127.0.0.1:4601>. The first start seeds an `admin` account. If `TS_ADMIN_PASSWORD` is not set, a random one-time password is generated and printed **once** in the startup banner: ```bash grep '一次性初始口令' .run/server.log # or: ./touchstone.sh status ``` You will be asked to change it on first login. Set `TS_ADMIN_PASSWORD=<your-password>` before the first start to skip the one-time password (and the forced change). > **Plugin mode (`dsh`) is password-free by default** (2026-10-08): the shell passes > `TS_ADMIN_PASSWORDLESS=1`, so the seeded `admin` has an **empty password** and no forced change — the > panel is auto-logged-in as `admin` anyway. Set a password in **Settings → Change password** whenever you > want one (it then becomes the password used for direct/standalone logins). The plugin also writes the > backend's stdout/stderr line by line to `<db dir>/plugin-backend.log` (next to > `~/.touchstone/touchstone.db`) — that is where the plugin-mode startup banner and the > `[board]`/`[waitq]`/`[runner]` diagnostics can be read. > Standalone mode gives you the full site — projects, case library, bug reports, board, queue, monitoring — > but **agent execution needs plugin mode** (below), because the agent runs inside the `dsh` host process. ### 3. Run as a `dsh` plugin (recommended: enables agent execution) The plugin embeds Touchstone in the `dsh` Web UI as a sidebar entry and panel, and lets Touchstone drive resident agent sessions in the host process. **Option A — from npm (self-contained package: whole platform + prebuilt front end):** ```bash npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web # 1) start the dsh host once (creates ~/.dsh/profiles/web) dsh plugin --profile web add @gavinc-cn/touchstone-dsh # 2) install the plugin package # 3) select the bundle in the profile manifest (the Plugins panel toggle does the same thing): node ~/.dsh/profiles/web/node_modules/@gavinc-cn/touchstone-dsh/dsh-plugin/scripts/select-bundle.mjs \ ~/.dsh/profiles/web/package.json # 4) restart the dsh web UI, open http://127.0.0.1:3080, use the Touchstone entry (Alt+T toggles the panel) ``` **Plugin mode needs no Python by default.** Since 2026-10-15 the plugin shell starts the bundled Node backend (it probes the host Node for `node:sqlite` first; if the host is too old it shows a hint page with the two ways out). Python is used only for the Python backend — standalone mode, or `backend: python` in the plugin config, which is the one-line fallback during the observation window (deleting the key no longer reverts anything: the default *is* `node` now). For that Python backend, the platform's own dependencies are installed with pip, not npm: ```bash pip install -r ~/.dsh/profiles/web/node_modules/@gavinc-cn/touchstone-dsh/backend_py/requirements.txt # Windows: python -m pip install ... (the official installer ships python.exe, not python3) ``` With the Python backend, the plugin resolves the interpreter itself when you do not configure one: it probes `python` first, then `python3` (the same order as `touchstone.cmd`), and uses the first one that actually runs. If that is not the interpreter where you installed the dependencies, the missing-dependency page prints the exact command for the interpreter it picked; to pin another one, set `pythonPath` in the profile patch: ```yaml - id: touchstone-dsh config: { backend: python, pythonPath: /path/to/python } ``` No `repoDir` is needed: the package carries both backends (`backend/` for Node, `backend_py/` for Python) and `webui/dist-plugin`, so the plugin falls back to its own directory. **Option B — from a checkout (development):** ```bash cd touchstone-dsh ./dsh-plugin/install.sh # idempotent install of this checkout into the profile ``` The installer prints the optional profile patch for pointing the plugin at your working copy (or picking a specific interpreter); skip it to use the package's own directory: ```yaml - id: touchstone-dsh config: { repoDir: /path/to/touchstone-dsh, pythonPath: /path/to/python3 } ``` Both run modes share one database (`~/.touchstone/touchstone.db` by default) and are mutually exclusive while running; the second instance refuses to start and tells you who holds the lock. ### Windows A cross-platform launcher offers the same commands: ```bash python touchstone.py start | stop | restart | status | build | test ``` ### First steps in the UI 1. Sign in and open **Settings → Change password** if you used the one-time password. 2. **Add project** — source directory, work directory (defaults to `<project>/.touchstone`), and the guidance the agent should follow. The case library and bug report directories are derived and created for you. 3. Create a task (or a board card) and let the queue pick it up. Round logs stream live; the session window shows the transcript as it grows. ## Configuration | Variable | Default | Purpose | |----------|---------|---------| | `TS_PORT` / `TS_HOST` | `4601` / `127.0.0.1` | Listen address. Use `TS_HOST=0.0.0.0` to expose the site on your LAN | | `TS_PYTHON` | `python3` | Interpreter used by the launcher (must have the runtime dependencies) | | `TOUCHSTONE_DB` | `~/.touchstone/touchstone.db` | SQLite database. Must live on a local disk — file locking does not work on CIFS/network shares | | `TS_ADMIN_PASSWORD` | *(random, printed once)* | Initial `admin` password; setting it skips the forced change | | `TS_ADMIN_PASSWORDLESS` | `1` in plugin mode | Seed `admin` with an empty password and no forced change (the plugin shell sets this); ignored when `TS_ADMIN_PASSWORD` is set | | `TS_WEB_DIR` | `webui/dist` | Static front-end directory the server serves | | `TOUCHSTONE_RUN_DIR` | `.run/` in the repository | PID / log / port files | | `TS_EXT_DIR` | `extensions` | Root of the built-in asset manifests | | `TS_ARCHIVE_SYNC` | `1` | Keep board "Done" and `dsh` session archive in sync (set `0` to disable) | | `TS_DSH_PROFILE` / `TS_DSH_PYTHON` | `web` / auto-detected | `dsh` profile and interpreter used by the plugin installer | Runtime paths inside a project's work directory: | Path | Contents | |------|----------| | `free_style/` | Case library (cases, status files, indexes) | | `bug_report/` | Bug reports, one directory per report | | `.web/` | Round logs, chat logs, stress metrics and reports | | `.live/live.json` | Agent live state used by the monitoring page | | `board_media/` | Attachments pasted onto board cards | ## Capabilities and limits | Area | Supported | |------|-----------| | Agent sessions | Create, resume, reply, inject into the running turn, cancel, compact, fork, rewind-by-fork, model and permission-preset switching (presets follow your DSH permission catalog) | | Session observability | Full transcript rendering, archive state, attachment preview, live status stream (no polling) | | Tasks | Six types, seven stages, stop conditions, date-range scoping, per-round logs, restart, continue | | Board | Cards across five columns, drag & drop, queue position, parent dependencies, scheduled start, trash, isolated worktrees | | Case library | Derived indexes, change-based retest triage, optional semantic (RAG) search | | Stress testing | Scenario validation, concurrent load, second-by-second metrics, charts, Markdown/JSON reports per run | | Notifications | Feishu (Lark) outbound push, inbound commands, and answering questions from chat cards | | Multi-user | Login, admin/user roles, per-project ownership checks on every project-scoped endpoint | Known limitations, stated plainly: - **The UI is currently Chinese-only.** - **Agent execution requires plugin mode**; standalone mode is the site without the agent. - **Rewind and "compact into a new session" are approximations** — rewind starts a new branch at an earlier point (the original session is kept), rather than truncating in place. - **No error banner for failed model requests** — `dsh` has no event for it, so the session window shows what the host reported and nothing more. - **The Windows launcher is implemented but `dsh` itself has not been verified on Windows yet.** - **End-to-end test scripts are not distributed** in this repository (see below), so `test-full` and `test-ui` report a skip rather than running. ## Repository layout ``` touchstone-dsh/ ├── backend/ Node backend (the plugin-mode default): server.js + lib/ + routes/ + schema/ ├── backend_py/ Python backend: server.py, runner.py, waitq.py, board.py, chat.py, db.py, … │ (+ requirements.txt). Legacy-but-kept; used by standalone mode / backend: python ├── builtin_prompts/ Prompt assets injected into first-round prompts ├── dsh-plugin/ The dsh plugin package (thin Node shell + driver + client bundle) ├── extensions/ Built-in assets installable from the settings page ├── webui/ React + Vite front end ├── tests/ pytest / vitest suites and the isolated-instance harness └── touchstone.sh|py|cmd Launchers (Linux / cross-platform / Windows) ``` ## Development ```bash ./touchstone.sh build # install front-end deps and build webui/dist ./touchstone.sh test # backend pytest + front-end vitest ./touchstone.sh test-full # + isolated end-to-end scripts (scripts are not distributed here) ./touchstone.sh test-ui # Playwright end-to-end (needs a running site; scripts not distributed) cd webui && npm run dev # front-end dev server on :5173, /api proxied to :4601 ``` Optional commit gate: ```bash git config core.hooksPath githooks # pre-commit runs the fast test layer (SKIP_TS_TESTS=1 to skip once) ``` See [tests/README.md](tests/README.md) for the test matrix and prerequisites. ## Security notes - The site listens on `127.0.0.1` by default and requires a login. Exposing it (`TS_HOST=0.0.0.0`) puts it on your network — do that deliberately. - Every project-scoped endpoint checks ownership before returning data; the `admin` account is the only administrator and cannot be renamed or deleted. - The agent runs with the permission preset you configure. The default is the most permissive one (no approval prompts), which is convenient and sharp-edged: **review the project guidance and the preset before pointing it at a repository you care about.** - Passwords are stored with the hashing scheme the project was specified against (unsalted MD5 for new passwords, PBKDF2-SHA256 for legacy seed accounts). Treat this as a local-development-grade store. ## License [MIT](LICENSE) © Touchstone contributors

No candidate code or lifecycle hooks were executed; runtime safety and compatibility are unproven.

# DSH Copy Image Menu

在 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 的助手消息复制按钮旁，增加一个 **下载 PNG** 图标按钮。

原生复制按钮保持原样：它继续复制 Markdown，不弹菜单，也不被插件接管。下载按钮只负责把当前助手消息渲染成一张适合分享的 PNG。

![DSH](https://img.shields.io/badge/DSH-Web%20UI-2563eb)
![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-green)

> 这是一个客户端插件，所有渲染和下载都在浏览器本地完成。不会上传消息内容。

---

## 功能

- 在助手消息的原生复制按钮旁增加一个下载图标按钮。
- 点击下载按钮，把当前助手消息渲染成 PNG 并下载。
- 不改变原生复制按钮的行为，Markdown 复制仍由 DSH 自己处理。
- 保留 Markdown 的标题、段落、列表、引用、表格、链接、行内代码和代码块样式。
- 使用当前主题的计算样式，深色/浅色主题都能生成接近界面的图片。
- 行内代码默认不拆行，避免 `180px`、`Ctrl+Shift+R` 被断成两截。
- 自动检测内容的横向溢出并加宽画布（最多 2000px），减少复杂卡片、表格或长链接在右侧被截断。
- 图片按最多 2 倍分辨率导出，长消息会自动缩放，避免超过 Canvas 尺寸限制。
- 样式渲染失败时自动回退为纯文本 PNG。
- 下载按钮有四种状态：空闲、生成中、完成、失败。
- 界面文案支持简体中文和英文。

## 界面

```text
助手消息
─────────────────────────────────────
  [复制]  [下载 PNG]  [反馈]  [分支]      19:42
```

下载按钮使用与原生操作行一致的 28px 尺寸、17px 图标、主题色和 hover 背景。它的 `aria-label` / `title` 会在生成中、完成和失败时变化。

---

## 安装

### 环境

- DeepSeek Harness Web UI
- 已在 DSH `0.2.1-rc.2` / Chromium 上测试
- 插件安装依赖 DSH 自带的插件管理器（底层使用 pnpm）

### 从 GitHub 安装

```bash
dsh plugin add "github:gghyoo/dsh-copy-image-menu"
```

安装完成后刷新 Web UI。如果按钮没有出现，打开 **Settings → Plugins**，确认 `@local/dsh-copy-image-menu` 已启用，然后硬刷新页面。

### 从本地目录安装

```bash
git clone https://github.com/gghyoo/dsh-copy-image-menu.git
cd dsh-copy-image-menu
dsh plugin add "$PWD"
```

### 更新

```bash
dsh plugin add "github:gghyoo/dsh-copy-image-menu"
```

或者重新拉取本地目录后刷新页面。插件是纯 JavaScript，没有构建步骤。

### 卸载

```bash
dsh plugin remove "@local/dsh-copy-image-menu"
```

安装或卸载后，建议刷新浏览器页面；如果 DSH 提示需要重启，按提示重启。

---

## 使用

1. 找到一条已完成的助手消息。
2. 把鼠标移到消息下方，复制按钮旁会出现下载图标。
3. 点击下载图标。
4. 浏览器下载 `dsh-message-<时间戳>.png`。

PNG 只包含助手消息正文，不包含点赞、分支、时间、Token 用量等操作栏。

---

## 工作方式

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  A[点击复制按钮旁的下载图标] --> B[找到当前 turn-tail]
  B --> C[克隆最后一条 assistant-step]
  C --> D[内联计算样式]
  D --> E[图片资源转 data URL]
  E --> F[检测横向溢出并加宽]
  F --> G[SVG foreignObject]
  G --> H[base64 data URL 载入]
  H --> I[Canvas 绘制]
  I --> J[PNG Blob]
  J --> K[浏览器下载]
```

### 1. 通过 Slot 添加按钮

插件注册的是 DSH 的助手消息操作行 Slot：

```js
ctx.slots.inject('conversation.chat.assistant-actions', () => ctx.slots.register({
  name: 'conversation.chat.assistant-actions',
  id: 'download-image',
  order: 5,
  locale: NS,
}, DownloadAction));
```

这个 Slot 由 DSH 渲染在已定稿助手消息的 `IconActions` 行内。插件使用 `order: 5`，所以按钮出现在：

```text
原生复制按钮 → 下载按钮 → 反馈 → 分支
```

原生复制按钮不在 Slot 里，因此插件不拦截它，也不重新实现 Markdown 复制。

### 2. 找到当前消息

下载按钮自带一个 ref。点击时：

```js
const tail = buttonRef.current?.closest('[data-turn-tail]');
const target = findAssistantStep(tail);
```

`findAssistantStep()` 会向前查找最后一个 `assistant-step`，这样只会截取最终回复，不会把工具调用、思考过程或操作栏画进去。

### 3. 生成 PNG

生成流程尽量保持轻量：

1. 克隆 `assistant-step` 节点。
2. 把每个元素的计算样式内联到克隆节点里。
3. 将图片资源转换成 data URL，避免生成图片时依赖外部资源。
4. 检测子元素的右边界和 `scrollWidth`，按需加宽画布。
5. 用 SVG `foreignObject` 包住克隆内容。
6. 把 SVG 转成 **base64 data URL**，而不是 Blob URL。
7. 用 `Image` 载入 SVG，再绘制到 Canvas。
8. 通过 `canvas.toBlob()` 导出 PNG 并触发下载。

这里有一个容易踩的坑：把包含 `foreignObject` 的 SVG 用 Blob URL 载入后，Chromium 会把 Canvas 标记为 tainted，随后 `toBlob()` 抛出：

```text
SecurityError: Tainted canvases may not be exported.
```

因此代码使用 base64 data URL。

### 4. 横向溢出

复杂卡片、表格或长链接可能比聊天列更宽。插件会测量克隆内容中每个元素的实际右边界，并参考 `scrollWidth`：

- 如果内容超出当前宽度，就把画布加宽；
- 最多扩展到 2000 CSS px；
- 最多重新布局 3 次；
- 这样避免右侧内容被 Canvas 直接裁掉。

### 5. 行内代码不拆行

对于非 `pre` 内的短行内 `code`（不超过 40 个字符），插件会强制：

```css
white-space: nowrap;
overflow-wrap: normal;
word-break: normal;
```

避免 `180px`、`Ctrl+Shift+R` 这类短代码在图片里被拆成两行。长行内代码仍然允许换行，防止撑破图像。

### 6. 纯文本兜底

如果复杂消息导致 `foreignObject` 渲染失败，插件会退化为纯文本 Canvas：

- 提取助手消息的 `innerText`；
- 按图像宽度逐字换行；
- 生成一张可下载的 PNG。

样式会有损失，但不会直接报「生成图片失败」。

---

## 为什么是下载 PNG，不是复制图片？

浏览器只有在 **安全上下文**（HTTPS 或 `localhost`）下才允许 `navigator.clipboard.write()` 写入 `image/png`。当前 DSH 如果通过 `http://局域网IP:端口` 访问，`navigator.clipboard` 通常不可用。

之前尝试过用选区 + `document.execCommand('copy')` 兜底，但 Chromium 实际只写入 `text/html`，微信、钉钉等桌面应用不会把它当作图片粘贴。为避免「提示复制成功、实际粘不出来」，现在只提供可靠的 **下载 PNG**。

如果后续在 HTTPS 或 localhost 环境下增加图片剪贴板能力，可以复用现有的 PNG Blob，再调用：

```js
await navigator.clipboard.write([
  new ClipboardItem({ 'image/png': blob })
]);
```

---

## 兼容性与限制

- 只处理助手消息，不修改用户消息的复制按钮。
- 依赖 DSH 当前的 DOM 标记（`data-turn-tail`、`data-chat-flow-kind="assistant-step"`）。如果上游 UI 大改，选择器可能需要同步更新。
- 复杂交互组件（例如 Canvas 图表、iframe、Shadow DOM、部分第三方 Widget）在 PNG 中可能只呈现静态外观或空白；纯文本兜底不会保留这些组件。
- 内容宽度最多扩展到 2000 CSS px；超过这个宽度的极端内容仍可能被裁切。
- 超长消息会缩放到 Canvas 限制内，极长内容可能被截断。
- 生成图片在浏览器本地完成，不上传消息内容；但如果消息里包含远程图片，插件会尝试 `fetch` 这些图片并转成 data URL，以便嵌入 PNG。
- 插件不发布到 npm；从 GitHub 或本地目录安装。
- 建议使用 Chromium 内核浏览器；Safari/Firefox 的 `foreignObject` 和字体渲染可能有差异。

---

## 项目结构

```text
.
├── client.js            # 浏览器端：下载按钮、PNG 渲染
├── index.js             # Host 端占位
├── cordis.patch.yml     # DSH bundle patch
├── package.json
├── locale/
│   ├── zh.json          # 插件市场/设置页元数据
│   └── en.json
├── assets/
│   └── icon-180.png     # 市场卡片图标
├── icon.svg
├── LICENSE
└── README.md
```

Host 端没有业务逻辑，所有功能都在 `client.js`。

---

## 开发

### 语法检查

```bash
node --check client.js
node --check index.js
node -e "JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('package.json','utf8'))"
```

### 本地安装调试

```bash
dsh plugin add "$PWD"
```

修改 `client.js` 后，硬刷新浏览器页面（`Ctrl+Shift+R`）让新的客户端代码生效。

### 调试图片渲染

生成失败时，浏览器控制台会输出：

```text
copy-image-menu: download render failed ...
```

如果样式渲染失败并走了纯文本兜底，会输出：

```text
copy-image-menu: styled render failed, using text fallback ...
```

---

## 隐私

- 不上传消息、图片或会话内容。
- 不包含遥测、统计或外部字体请求。
- 只在用户点击下载按钮后读取当前消息 DOM。
- 生成的 PNG 只通过浏览器下载 API 保存到本地。

---

## FAQ

### 下载按钮没有出现？

1. 确认插件已启用：**Settings → Plugins → @local/dsh-copy-image-menu**。
2. 硬刷新页面。
3. 确认消息是已完成的助手消息；按钮在 hover 操作行里。
4. 查看浏览器控制台是否有插件加载错误。

### 下载的图片里代码被拆行？

请确认插件版本包含行内代码 `nowrap` 修复，并硬刷新页面。短行内代码（≤40 字符）默认不拆行。

### 图片右侧被裁切？

插件会自动检测横向溢出并加宽画布，最多 2000 CSS px。如果仍有裁切，把实际 PNG 发到 issue，附上消息内容和 DSH 版本。

### 为什么图片和界面不是 100% 一致？

图片渲染使用克隆 DOM + 计算样式 + Canvas。字体度量、复杂组件、跨域图片和浏览器渲染差异都可能造成细微差别。纯文本兜底只保证内容可读，不保证样式一致。

### 可以复制图片而不是下载吗？

在当前 HTTP 访问方式下不可靠。浏览器会限制图片剪贴板写入；微信/钉钉也不会把 HTML 兜底当成图片。下载 PNG 是当前版本稳定支持的方式。

---

## English Summary

DSH Copy Image Menu adds a **Download PNG** icon button next to the native assistant message copy button in the DeepSeek Harness Web UI. The native copy button is left untouched and still copies Markdown.

On click, the plugin clones the final assistant message, inlines its computed styles, expands the canvas for horizontal overflow, serializes it through SVG `foreignObject` and a base64 data URL, and exports a PNG through Canvas. The plugin has no server-side logic and uploads nothing.

Install:

```bash
dsh plugin add "github:gghyoo/dsh-copy-image-menu"
```

---

## License

requires granting notification permission); configured in the peak pricing panel in Settings, with a **one-click popup preview** (rendered by the real component — copy, position and notifications exactly as they will fire) | | Official price sync | Settings page | Fetches and parses the official pricing page, applies with one click; the **official price currency** is selectable (USD · English page / CNY · Chinese page) — CNY prices are booked at the display exchange rate and match the official CNY bill when displayed in CNY | | UI language | Settings → Display settings | Simplified Chinese / English / Follow DSH (auto); switches instantly and auto-saves | | Hide official balance / hide today's cost | Settings → Display settings | Two independent toggles: when on, the matching UI blocks (sidebar balance row & panels / today's cost row, budget details, overview today card) **are not rendered at all**; token and call-count stats stay visible — safe for screen sharing and screenshots | | AI price sync | [prompt](docs/AI-PRICE-SYNC-PROMPT.en.md) | DeepSeek official sync; other providers use the verified official price catalog and manual configuration | | Model & Plan adaptation guide | [adaptation doc](docs/model-and-plan-adaptation.en.md) | Adaptation matrix for per-model billing and the Coding Plan vendors, the auto-matching mechanism and price sources ([中文](docs/model-and-plan-adaptation.md)) | | Peak/off-peak alert guide | [alert doc](docs/peak-alert.en.md) | Fully illustrated guide to the pre-switch popup and system notification: effect screenshots (EN/中文), settings reference and usage tips ([中文](docs/peak-alert.md)) | | Token Plan usage stats guide | [panel doc](docs/token-plan-stats.md) | Meaning of the four columns in the per-1% & full-window panel, the end-to-end delta estimation method and precision tags, the scope boundary (dsh-made calls only) and usage curves ([中文](docs/token-plan-stats.md#中文)) | | OpenRouter passthrough pricing | [pricing doc](docs/openrouter-pricing.md#english) | Token reference prices: offline snapshot, scoped zero-cost backfill, public-catalog refresh, custom-price preservation and failure fallback ([中文](docs/openrouter-pricing.md)) | | Multi-provider billing | Settings / ledger | OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini, Mistral and other providers with input/output, cache and reasoning-token pricing isolated by provider + model | | Model-name auto-matching | Settings / ledger | Unknown model ids are matched against the price table: case/spaces/hyphens/dots and bracket annotations (e.g. (go)) are ignored — a normalized-equal or containing name hits (e.g. `gpt5.6 luna(go)`); router providers (opencode/zen etc.) search across all vendors; can be restricted to exact match, and unmatched models can be pinned to a specific entry in Settings | | Extended price catalog | Settings → Extended price catalog | Built-in reference catalog grouped by vendor and model family (expandable; vendors collapsed by default); mount entries into billing with one click — mounted third-party models live inside the catalog and stay editable; a per-model “Show directly in Cost settings” toggle chooses which models (DeepSeek included) appear directly in the price table | ## Custom provider balance example (NewApi template) **POST with a JSON body:** in **Settings → Cost → Quota**, expand a custom balance entry, select **POST**, then fill in **Request body (JSON)**. For example, if the endpoint expects an account and returns `{"data":{"balance":12.5}}`: ```json {"account_id":"example-account","include_credit":true} ``` Set **Extract rules (JSON)** to `{"remaining":"data.balance"}`. Valid JSON is saved per entry and sent exactly as entered, including nested values and large integer IDs. Invalid JSON shows an error and keeps the last valid configuration; clearing the editor removes the body. GET/HEAD send no body while retaining it for a later switch back to POST. `Content-Type: application/json` is added automatically unless you supply a Content-Type header (any capitalization). Existing `request.body` objects and raw strings remain supported. The body is ordinary saved configuration; `{{VAR}}` credential substitution applies only to request headers. For header authentication, use a reference such as `{"Authorization":"Bearer {{MY_API_KEY}}"}` and the credential input below it. **Display currency conversion:** open **Settings → Cost → Quota**, expand a custom balance entry, and enable **Convert USD balance to display currency**. It defaults to off for each entry. Keep **Source currency** set to the endpoint's actual currency. With a USD balance of 54.3792, a CNY display rate of 7.2 and two decimal places, the balance displays as **¥391.53**. Spend and API/manual limits convert together in the sidebar, settings and tooltips; progress percentages and stored balances do not change. Enter a manual limit in the source currency. The setting persists as `convertToDisplayCurrency: true` inside that `customBalances[]` entry (legacy `customBalance` is also supported). The global exchange rate converts **USD to the display currency**. CNY/EUR source balances and Credits keep their original units; the switch is disabled for them. Alibaba Cloud balances use the currency returned by its API. No exchange-rate lookup or extra balance request is made when toggling this setting. Turning it off restores the original currency immediately. **DeepSeek CNY billing:** USD prices × the display exchange rate and the official CNY table can give different amounts. Settings → Cost → Prices now explains this and provides a CNY selection button. See [currency selection, sync and settlement timing](docs/billing-currency.md#english). For Qianwen / Alibaba Cloud fund accounts, use **Add Qianwen / Alibaba Cloud balance** to query available funds with a RAM AccessKey signature. The card uses the currency returned by the API. See the [setup, permissions and balance definition](docs/qianwen-balance.md#english). Qwen Token Plan can use the [official CLI subscription quota](docs/qwen-cli-quota.md#english). Install the CLI on the DSH host and run `qianwen auth login` as the same OS user. Local estimates remain the default; CLI mode shows current account credits without changing the local ledger. Local Qwen Token Plan credits include Plan calls assigned to Qwen. Existing subscription aliases such as `qwen` and `qwen-tokenplan` remain supported; custom providers can select Qwen under Model statistics → Billing class, or use an explicit vendor name and plan marker for auto detection. Explicit API calls are excluded. The pay-as-you-go `qianwen` provider is not assigned merely because its model ID is identical. Models outside the credits table need all three rates configured. Baidu Qianfan Token Plan Personal now supports [quota queries via console Cookie](docs/baidu-token-plan.md), including credits and Token modes. Store the Cookie in the Baidu quota card or set `BAIDU_QIANFAN_COOKIE` on the DSH host. Xiaomi MiMo Token Plan quotas are queried with the **MiMo console cookie**, not an API key: log in at `platform.xiaomimimo.com`, press F12 → Network → find the `balanceAlertConfig` request and paste the full `cookie` request header into the MiMo card in Settings → Cost → Quotas (it must include `serviceToken` and `userId`; the DSH credential store keeps it as `MIMO_COOKIE`). The card shows the plan/compensation credit windows with the period-end reset (Beijing time) plus a balance row. Copy a fresh console cookie when the card reports an expired login. Token Plan inference keys (`tp-*` / `ttp-*`) are not accepted by this console adapter. Local plan statistics use the calendar month; compensation and balance are displayed without estimates because local calls cannot be attributed to those pools. Each CLIProxyAPI source has a **Gemini quota only** option for its Antigravity groups. It defaults to off. Intentional filtering to no visible quota shows an empty list; malformed quota data still reports an error. The `extract` rules accept four forms: a numeric constant, a dot path string, `add`/`subtract` over multiple paths, and `divide` scaling by a `by` divisor. **`divide` fits NewApi and other endpoints that meter balance in integer quota** (1 USD = 500000 quota — the same conversion cc-switch uses). - **`unit: "CREDITS"`**: displays non-monetary credits using the configured decimal precision and a Credits suffix. Dollar spend is not converted to credits or shown as today's credit usage. Credit bars use the endpoint's credit cap; the global monetary budget does not apply. - **Plain HTTP is allowed for loopback endpoints**: `http://` is accepted when the host is `127.0.0.1` / `localhost` / `[::1]` (the traffic never leaves the machine), which covers local read-only routes that listen on loopback only and serve no TLS (e.g. `dsh-workbuddy-connect`'s `/plugins/dsh-workbuddy-connect/status`). **Every non-loopback host still requires https**; plaintext is refused. ### WorkBuddy credits example (local plugin route) The dedicated **WorkBuddy credits** quota card now supports dsh-xdpool. Select **Credit source → dsh-xdpool** when using multiple connectors; current, all and selected accounts work across CN/global pools. See the [integration notes](docs/update-notes-1.9.38.md#english). With `dsh-workbuddy-connect` installed, its web status route already returns the aggregated credit total — no credential needs to be copied: ```json { "enabled": true, "display": "sidebar", "refreshMinutes": 15, "label": "WorkBuddy 积分", "labelEn": "WorkBuddy Credits", "unit": "CREDITS", "request": { "url": "http://127.0.0.1:3080/plugins/dsh-workbuddy-connect/status", "method": "GET", "headers": {} }, "extract": { "remaining": "credits.total" } } ``` Adjust the port and response fields to the local service. This example requires the other plugin to expose that route. Cost-meter refuses redirects and continues to enforce configured credential host allowlists. For NewApi `GET /api/usage/token` (response `{ "code": 200, "data": { "total_granted": ..., "total_used": ..., "total_available": ..., "unlimited_quota": false } }`): ```json { "enabled": true, "display": "both", "refreshMinutes": 15, "label": "NewApi", "labelEn": "NewApi", "unit": "USD", "request": { "url": "https://your-newapi-host/api/usage/token", "method": "GET", "headers": { "Authorization": "Bearer {{NEWAPI_API_KEY}}" } }, "extract": { "remaining": { "op": "divide", "path": "data.total_available", "by": 500000 }, "maxBudget": { "op": "divide", "path": "data.total_granted", "by": 500000 }, "spend": { "op": "divide", "path": "data.total_used", "by": 500000 }, "unit": "USD" } } ``` - `{{NEWAPI_API_KEY}}` resolves from the DSH credential vault or an environment variable (**placeholders work in headers only** — the URL must be a literal address); - Unlimited-quota tokens (`unlimited_quota: true`) have no `total_available`, so `remaining` cannot be extracted and the query reports “remaining is missing or not numeric” — use a limited-quota token or a middle-layer endpoint that converts the units; - Entry point: Settings → Cost (Quota tab) → “Custom provider balance” → expand config; or write `config.customBalance` in `storages/cost-meter/ledger.json`. ### Credentials & security - **Variable naming**: `{{VAR_NAME}}` follows the `_API_KEY` convention — `` is the Provider ID from the DSH Models page (Settings → Models), uppercased with non-alphanumeric characters replaced by underscores, e.g. `openai`→`{{OPENAI_API_KEY}}`, `anthropic`→`{{ANTHROPIC_API_KEY}}`, `abc23-d`→`{{ABC23_D_API_KEY}}`. Sharing a name with the Models page means the balance query and model calls **share the same key** (both resolve from the DSH credential store). This note is also shown above the “Headers (JSON)” input in Settings. - **Credential input fields**: after expanding an entry, the “Credential input” section renders one write-only field per `{{VAR}}` placeholder found in the headers — the key goes straight into the DSH credential store (never written to disk, never echoed back, never stored in `ledger.json`); no need to hand-edit environment variables or credential files. - **Automatic plaintext migration**: older versions let a literal `Bearer sk-…` in the headers leak into `ledger.json` in plaintext. The plugin imports such keys into the DSH credential store at startup and replaces the header value with a `{{CUSTOM_BALANCE_KEY_…}}` placeholder (derived from the entry's host + header name, stable across restarts) — nothing breaks. From now on `ledger.json` and the config shipped to the browser **never contain plaintext keys**: suspected secret headers (Authorization / X-Api-Key / Bearer / sk- prefixes / long opaque strings) are blanked, while placeholders and ordinary headers pass through. - **Credential allowlist `allowedHosts`**: when headers carry credentials (placeholders or plaintext), the outbound host must be on this list or the request is refused — protection against leaked keys when importing someone else's config. Without a list, requests proceed with a one-time logged warning. The entry panel provides an “Allowed hosts” input (comma-separated). - **Mixed credential templates**: a header containing both a static secret and dynamic placeholders cannot be migrated as one nested credential. It is reported as pending and excluded from persisted/client config. Store the static part separately and use credential references throughout. Pure forms such as `Bearer {{VAR}}` and `{{USER}}:{{PASS}}` remain supported. ## CLIProxyAPI Gateway Quotas and WorkBuddy Credits (Issue #87) Connects to a local or LAN-deployed [CLIProxyAPI](https://github.com/router-for-me/CLIProxyAPI) proxy gateway to observe quotas across upstream providers and WorkBuddy plugin credits in one place: - **Native Multi-Provider Discovery & Quotas**: Auto-discovers active credentials via the CPA Management API and queries official native endpoints for Antigravity, Claude, Codex, Kimi, and xAI (Grok). Normalized into standard 5h / 7d / weekly / monthly usage percentage windows with ISO reset timestamps. - **WorkBuddy Plugin Credits**: Queries WorkBuddy's read-only management route (`/v0/management/plugins/workbuddy/credits`) to display total, used, and remaining credit balances alongside package lifecycle end-dates, preserving separate account cards. - **Zero Metering Side-Effects Guarantee**: Completely read-only — strictly avoids mutating actions such as Codex reset-credit consume, xAI token-consuming chat completion probes, and any WorkBuddy POST routes. - **Strict Credential Isolation & Transport Security**: - Management Keys are stored strictly write-only in the DSH credential store (`CLIPROXYAPI_MANAGEMENT_KEY__`), never exposed in config, state, or browser views. - Management calls are strictly restricted to 3 fixed paths (`/v0/management/auth-files`, `/v0/management/api-call`, `/v0/management/plugins/workbuddy/credits`). Arbitrary upstream URLs are forbidden. - Outbound host whitelist (`allowedHosts`): Non-loopback origins require exact host matches, and plain HTTP requires an explicit `allowInsecureHttp` opt-in. - HTTP redirects are strictly forbidden (`redirect: 'manual'`; any 3xx response is rejected) to guard against credential leakage or request hijacking. - Privacy and metadata sanitization: Strips raw tokens, cookies, and identity claims from auth-files discovery; emails are masked in public state (`s***@domain`). ## Bilingual UI The plugin UI (session badge, sidebar balance row & budget box, and the entire Settings page) supports **Simplified Chinese** and **English**: - Language options: **Simplified Chinese** / **English** / **Follow DSH (auto)**; - Default is “Follow DSH”: auto uses DSH’s active language and updates live, including the statistics screen and Settings sidebar label. Older hosts without the locale face use the saved DSH preference when available, then the browse

whole dark logo](https://hol.org/brand/Logo_Whole_Dark.png) | **Stop risky AI actions before they compromise your machine.** HOL Guard is a local-first security layer for AI agents, tools, plugins, skills, MCP servers, and package installs.

[Install HOL Guard](https://hol.org/guard/activate)
